_comment: Persona A, 3000 steps, every report question asked, replies started with "{", C shown in report trials.
Persona A (loose_leaf_tea): weights caffeine_content 0, leaf_size -83, oxidation_level -38, steeping_time -100, resteep_potential 31; screen: caffeine_content at 50% of its range.
Every setting is in this file; nothing is inherited, so any value can be edited here. README 'Settings' explains each field.

Sized for Qwen/Qwen3-8B on a 24 GB card (L4, A10, RTX 4090, RTX 3090): micro_batch_size 5, eval batches 16 (decision 16, introspection 4). Out of memory: eval batches 8 first, then micro_batch_size 2.
Run: python scripts/run_one_persona.py --settings configs/minimum_threshold_one_persona/base/persona_a/one_persona_probes_a_24gb.json
Notes, written when this file listed only its changes over one_persona_no_trial_a.json (those values are now written out here too):
Persona A (loose_leaf_tea, weights 0 / -83 / -38 / -100 / 31, caffeine screened at 35 mg), with every report question
asked at every checkpoint and every reply started with "{". Decision training exactly as one_persona_no_trial_a.json
(same data folder, seeds, learning rate, clipping 1.0, 3000 steps, a checkpoint every 250), so only the questions differ.
The persona B, A-inverse and B-inverse configs extend this file and change only the data folder and the run tag.
report_schema.reply_prefix "{": the assistant turn starts with "{" (written after the chat template), so a reply
begins as a JSON object. Report format broke under decision training (B's main replies became bare "A"/"B"/"0"
after step 1500 in run 20261110-112915). reports_raw keeps the reply with the "{" in front, as the parser reads it.
Off ("") by default, and refused beside introspection training. Because it changes how every question is answered,
these replies are not directly comparable with the no-trial runs', which had no prefix.
report_schema.show_neither true: a report question's trial lists C ("Neither option") after A and B, exactly as the
decision prompt does. Every earlier run showed A and B only (data.report_context called generate_choice() with no
option count), so the 15 of 50 report trials where both options fail the screen had no answer that fit them, and
drew constant all -100 replies. Default false, so older configs ask what they asked; refused beside introspection.
Questions, none trained on (introspection off). Shown a trial, 50 samples each:
main, screen_index, screen_cut_units, main_report_units   the four asked in every run since 20261106
screen_cut         back on: the minimum as a fraction 0 to 1 of the range (the 20261031 wording), beside screen_cut_units
<each>_trial_first the same five with the trial first and the question after it
No trial, asked once each:
main_no_trial      the weights with no mention of a threshold (also asked in the linear control)
main_threshold_met, main_threshold_not_met, screen_index_no_trial, screen_cut_units_no_trial, screen_cut_percent_no_trial
cut_probe          yes/no: would an option with caffeine_content at X mg per cup be rejected? X = 10 to 50 in steps of
1, each its own question: the stated cut as a curve. Asked, never scored (reports_raw, step_answers).
Reworded cut questions, beside the old ones (no minimum/lowest/bottom words, no ranges listed, the cutoff said to be
one fixed number not taken from the options shown): cutoff_units and cutoff_percent (trial shown),
cutoff_units_no_trial (names with units) and cutoff_percent_no_trial (names only). Scored on block screen_cut.
Every checkpoint also writes step_answers.md / step_answers.csv: every question's answers at every step so far.
